question: The signs of charges of electron, proton and neutron are __________, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is __**negative, positive and neutral**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The charge of an **electron** is **negative**.
 
• The charge of a **proton** is **positive**.
 
• The charge of a **neutron** is **neutral** (no charge).
